description: A clock with four pulse outputs: one at the tempo knob's rate, and three more each offset from it by a percentage, all restarted together by the resync

params.text: Sets the base tempo for all four channels, 30 to 360 pulses per minute
Offsets the channel b tempo from the tempo knob, -10% to 10%
Attenuates and inverts the channel b offset CV, -1 to 1, before it is added to the channel b offset knob
Offsets the channel c tempo from the tempo knob, -10% to 10%
Attenuates and inverts the channel c offset CV, -1 to 1, before it is added to the channel c offset knob
Offsets the channel d tempo from the tempo knob, -10% to 10%
Attenuates and inverts the channel d offset CV, -1 to 1, before it is added to the channel d offset knob
Restarts all four channels' counters and fires a pulse on each at that instant

inputs.text: A rising edge past 1V restarts all four channels' counters and fires a pulse on each
Shifts the channel b offset by 2% per volt with the channel b attenuverter fully clockwise, and the total offset is clamped between -10% and 10%
Shifts the channel c offset by 2% per volt with the channel c attenuverter fully clockwise, and the total offset is clamped between -10% and 10%
Shifts the channel d offset by 2% per volt with the channel d attenuverter fully clockwise, and the total offset is clamped between -10% and 10%

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse to 10V at the rate set by the tempo knob, with no offset applied to it
A 1ms pulse to 10V at the tempo knob's rate altered by the channel b offset
A 1ms pulse to 10V at the tempo knob's rate altered by the channel c offset
A 1ms pulse to 10V at the tempo knob's rate altered by the channel d offset

notes: channel a is the reference and has no offset control of its own; the other three are set relative to it
the four channels are free-running counters, so any offset at all pulls them steadily apart; the resync button and the resync input are the only things that bring them back together
nothing on the panel is lettered; the artwork carries the module name and no control labels at all
